resources.string: Your private assistant stays locked until you unlock it.

This irreversibly erases stored memories, provider keys, active work, and policy settings. The App PIN is preserved. Security lockdown remains active until you authenticate and release it. Provider keys must be entered again.
Recovery requires an unlocked app and explicit confirmation. Provider keys are cleared and must be entered again.
